title: 第一卷 第11章 时差第一卷 第12章 私奔
lines: 林风眠难以置信道：“你真不是鬼，真能从玉佩出去？”
“呸呸呸，你才是鬼呢，我当然能从这里出去！”
洛雪噘着嘴，对这满嘴谎言的登徒浪子实在没什么好感。
林风眠踉踉跄跄后退，眼中满是震惊之色。
如果这女人不是不知道她已经死了，那就只有一种可能。
两人之间有着一千年的时差！
这就是她没在天元找到玉仙宗的原因。
玉仙宗建宗不久，满打满算也就几百年！
想到这里，林风眠心中一阵绝望。
女鬼起码还能附身在自己身上，帮自己对付柳媚。
但活在千年前的已故剑仙，还能劈开千年时光来救自己吗？
“完了，这下真的死定了！”
洛雪看林风眠万念俱灰的模样，也不由动摇了。
这家伙的绝望眼神不像是装的，难道自己错怪他了？
那玉仙宗只是规模太小，以至于地图上并未记载？
“你先别垂头丧气的，你在玉仙宗有没有找到它的具体方位？”
林风眠自嘲一笑，先不说空间上来不来得及，时间上你就没办法啊！
他摇了摇头道：“没有，那些妖女将地图都藏了起来。”
洛雪也不由柳眉微蹙，着急道：“这可怎么办！”
林风眠也不想坐以待毙，想到眼前之人是一位绝世剑仙。
他不由期待道：“仙子，你有没有能让实力暴涨的秘法？”
洛雪认真想了想，尴尬道：“什么秘法也做不到让炼气战筑基啊！”
林风眠不甘心道：“那有没有锁住阳气的秘法？”
“呃……我不会……”
“让人不识抬举的呢？”
“什么不识抬举？”
“就是让男子那个无动于衷的秘法！”
洛雪好一会才反应过来，红着脸摇了摇头。
“也没有，其实这种宗门一般都有秘法刺激男子的……”
林风眠顿时垂头丧气，叹息道：“难道只能斩草除根，让妖女无计可施了吗？”
洛雪愣了一下才反应过来，看着林风眠，不由肃然起敬。
这色胚是个汉子！
可惜很快就不是了！
“这倒是个法子，留得青山在，不怕没柴烧，性命要紧！”
content_en:
Lin Fengmian said in disbelief: "You are really not a ghost. Can you really escape from the jade pendant?"
"Bah, bah, bah, you are the ghost. Of course I can get out of here!"
Luo Xue pursed her lips, she really didn't like this prodigal son who was full of lies.
Lin Fengmian staggered back, his eyes full of shock.
If this woman didn't know she was dead, there was only one possibility.
There is a thousand-year time difference between the two!
This was the reason why she didn't find the Jade Immortal Sect in Tianyuan.
The Jade Immortal Sect was established not long ago, so it will only take a few hundred years to fully plan!
Thinking of this, Lin Fengmian felt despair in his heart.
At least the female ghost can possess him and help him deal with Liu Mei.
But can the late swordsman who lived a thousand years ago still split a thousand years of time to save himself?
"It's over, I'm really dead now!"
Seeing Lin Fengmian's despair, Luo Xue couldn't help but be shaken.
This guy's desperate look doesn't look like he's pretending. Could it be that I'm wrongly blaming him?
Is the Jade Immortal Sect just too small in scale to be recorded on the map?
"Don't be downcast yet. Have you found its specific location in the Jade Immortal Sect?"
Lin Fengmian laughed at himself, "Not to mention the lack of time in terms of space, there is nothing you can do about time!"
He shook his head and said, "No, those witches hid all the maps."
Luo Xue couldn't help but frown slightly, and said anxiously: "What should I do?"
Lin Fengmian didn't want to sit still and wait for death, thinking that the person in front of him was a peerless swordsman.
He couldn't help but look forward to it: "Fairy, do you have a secret method that can increase your strength?"
Luo Xue thought about it seriously and said awkwardly: "No secret method can make Qi refining and foundation building possible!"
Lin Fengmian said unwillingly: "Is there a secret method for locking Yang Qi?"
"Uh...I won't..."
"What about people who don't appreciate praise?"
"Why don't you know how to appreciate someone?"
"It's the secret method that makes a man indifferent!"
Luo Xue took a while to react, blushing and shaking her head.
"No, in fact, this kind of sect usually has secret methods to stimulate men..."
Lin Fengmian suddenly became dejected and sighed: "Is it possible that we can only eliminate the weeds and leave the demon girl with nothing to do?"
Luo Xue was stunned for a moment before she came to her senses. She looked at Lin Fengmian in awe.
This pervert is a man!
Too bad it won’t be anymore soon!
"This is a good idea. Keep the green hills and don't worry about running out of firewood. Your life is at stake!"
